hooks.command: last=$(git log -1 --format='%cd' --date=format:'%Y-%m-%d' 2>/dev/null); today=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d'); [ "$last" = "$today" ] && exit 0; git add -A 2>/dev/null; git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "auto-save: $today"; git remote get-url origin > /dev/null 2>&1 && git push || true
hooks.statusMessage: Committing and pushing changes to GitHub...
